# A view's `for` over `xs.filter(f)` that reads state, on every target.
# passNoListLambdas hoists a filter into a loop building a temp before the
# statement it stands in, which on Go is what lets a function body call one;
# in a view that loop was a statement of the view, which reactivity made a
# render slot attaching no node, and the build panicked. A view's own
# expressions are left for the emitter, as a node's props already were.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

// Keeps what a function body filters, which is hoisted as it always was.
func longOnes(names list[string]) list[string] {
    return names.filter(func(n string) => string.length(n) > 2)
}

component names ui.node {
    var all = ["ab", "abc", "b", "bcd"]
    var prefix = "a"
    var picked = ""
    ui.vbox {
        for var n = all.filter(func(n string) => string.startsWith(n, prefix)) {
            ui.button #row(text=n, @click { picked = n })
        }
        if longOnes(all).filter(func(n string) => string.startsWith(n, prefix)).length() > 1 {
            ui.text #many(value="many")
        }
        ui.button #toB(text="b", @click { prefix = "b" })
        ui.button #more(text="more", @click { all.push("bee") })
    }
}

func testTheLoopFollowsWhatItFilters(t test.Test, c names) {
    c.row[1].click()
    t.assert(c.picked == "abc")
    c.toB.click()
    c.row[1].click()
    t.assert(c.picked == "bcd")
    c.more.click()
    c.row[2].click()
    t.assert(c.picked == "bee")
}

func testAConditionFiltersToo(t test.Test, c names) {
    t.assert(c.many == null)
    c.toB.click()
    c.more.click()
    t.assert(c.many != null)
}

ui.window {
    names()
}
